segments.dry: Multiple long-time users with dry skin report the cleanser leaves their face soft, hydrated and not stripped, even through winter, with several calling it the only cleanser that doesn't dry them out.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers generally describe it as gentle and non-irritating, but one reports a severe allergic reaction with redness, itching, welts and puffy eyes after several days of use.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention aging or menopausal skin describe the cleanser as non-drying and skin-softening, with one noting it reduced small bumps linked to menopause.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin found it left an oily film and did not clean makeup off, leaving skin feeling oily and dirty afterward.
segments.combination: A reviewer citing 25-35 years of use across changing skin found it consistently gentle and hydrating, though no combination-specific effect is detailed.
segments.normal: One reviewer specifically names the older formula as intended for normal to dry skin, reporting the newer version feels stickier and caused breakouts by comparison.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for mature or aging skin report their face looks and feels softer, smoother and more youthful over years of use, with one noting reduced small bumps from menopause; no negative reports specific to aging are mentioned.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin describe lasting hydration and no tightness or stripping, including through winter; no dissent is recorded for this concern.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the product calms and soothes skin, but another describes a severe reaction with red, itchy, painful welts after several days of use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the cleanser as non-stripping, preserving natural oils and comfortable even after microneedling; one dissenting review reports a damaged, reactive skin response with a rash-like reaction.
concerns.spots: One reviewer credits the cleanser with helping reduce small breakouts linked to menopause, while another reports it caused her skin to break out within a day of switching to the new formula.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: several users note no breakouts and clearer-feeling skin, but two describe new breakouts or reactions after switching to this reformulated version.
concerns.oiliness: Some reviewers report no greasiness and non-oily finish, while others with oily skin specifically report an oily film left on the face and incomplete makeup removal.

aspects.libelle: Does not fully remove makeup or mascara
New pump or snap container hard to close
Runs off hands, thinner than older formula

extraits.titre: Did not know it's an exfoliating/Caused bad skin reaction
extraits.texte: I wasn't aware that this was an exfoliating product. It is advertised as a gentle milky cleanser for sensitive skin not an exfoliant. On the 4th day using this I had a severe allergic reaction. My eyes were so puffy, and I didn't even use to remove eye makeup. My skin has welts and is so red an itchy and painful. If your skin is sensitive do not buy. Also, it should specifically say on the bottle that it is a chemical exfoliant. There is Citric acid listed.

I finally finished my last reserves of the older green cleansing milk for normal to dry skin, and was hoping this would be an easy transition. But upon using, it's so much stickier, felt like it left an film and it made my skin break out within a day. I hate when your favorite products go away and their replaced with something that feels worse. Now I'll have to change face wash brands after 17 years sadly.

I have been using this cleansing milk for years. My skin is very dry and sensitive and I can't use any cleansers that I have to rinse off - even water is too drying for me! This cleansing milk cleans off make-up and daily dirt with a tissue and never leaves an icky film or causes breakouts. I so love it. Feels gentle, clean and moisturizing.

I repurchased this cleanser after not using it for almost a year. I didn't realize how much I missed it. My skin is cleaner, smoother, glowing and feels so hydrated. It helped to reduce small pumps on my face caused my menopause. This is my holy grail. Highly recommend this.

Love this cleanser. First time to try it! Having very dry skin all my life, I am always trying cleansers that don't dry my face out! I think I have found my cleanser! It is nice and creamy and feels great on your face after washing it off. It even takes your mascara off also without burning your eyes! I think the price is very reasonable especially when you get it on sale!

extraits.titre: Terrible smell and doesn't cleanse at all
extraits.texte: Terrible smell…gave me a terrible headache. Didn't cleanse at all! My skin was oily and dirty after using. Put toner on with cotton pad after using and it was covered in leftover dirt.

I have skincare from this brand that i love so i decided to try this. I did like that it made my face feel soft but it was maybe too oily because my face didnt feel clean after using it. It also did not remove all my makeup. I ended up returning it.
